passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.1
passages.text: Mitius inveni quam te genus omne ferarum;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.2
passages.text: Credita non ulli quam tibi peius eram.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.3
passages.text: Quae legis, ex illo, Theseu, tibi litore mitto

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.4
passages.text: Unde tuam sine me vela tulere ratem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.5
passages.text: In quo me somnusque meus male prodidit et tu,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.6
passages.text: Per facinus somnis insidiate meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.7
passages.text: Tempus erat, vitrea quo primum terra pruina

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.8
passages.text: Spargitur et tectae fronde queruntur aves.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.9
passages.text: Incertum vigilans ac somno languida movi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.10
passages.text: Thesea prensuras semisupina manus —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.11
passages.text: Nullus erat! referoque manus iterumque retempto,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.12
passages.text: Perque torum moveo bracchia — nullus erat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.13
passages.text: Excussere metus somnum; conterrita surgo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.14
passages.text: Membraque sunt viduo praecipitata toro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.15
passages.text: Protinus adductis sonuerunt pectora palmis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.16
passages.text: Utque erat e somno turbida, rupta coma est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.17
passages.text: Luna fuit; specto, siquid nisi litora cernam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.18
passages.text: Quod videant oculi, nil nisi litus habent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.19
passages.text: Nunc huc, nunc illuc, et utroque sine ordine, curro;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.20
passages.text: Alta puellares tardat harena pedes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.21
passages.text: Interea toto clamavi in litore 'Theseu!':

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.22
passages.text: Reddebant nomen concava saxa tuum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.23
passages.text: Et quotiens ego te, totiens locus ipse vocabat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.24
passages.text: Ipse locus miserae ferre volebat opem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.25
passages.text: Mons fuit — apparent frutices in vertice rari;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.26
passages.text: Hinc scopulus raucis pendet adesus aquis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.27
passages.text: Adscendo — vires animus dabat — atque ita late

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.28
passages.text: Aequora prospectu metior alta meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.29
passages.text: Inde ego — nam ventis quoque sum crudelibus usa —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.30
passages.text: Vidi praecipiti carbasa tenta Noto.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.31
passages.text: Ut vidi haut dignam quae me vidisse putarem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.32
passages.text: Frigidior glacie semianimisque fui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.33
passages.text: Nec languere diu patitur dolor; excitor illo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.34
passages.text: Excitor et summa Thesea voce voco.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.35
passages.text: 'Quo fugis?' exclamo; 'scelerate revertere Theseu!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.36
passages.text: Flecte ratem! numerum non habet illa suum!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.37
passages.text: Haec ego; quod voci deerat, plangore replebam;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.38
passages.text: Verbera cum verbis mixta fuere meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.39
passages.text: Si non audires, ut saltem cernere posses,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.40
passages.text: Iactatae late signa dedere manus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.41
passages.text: Candidaque inposui longae velamina virgae —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.42
passages.text: Scilicet oblitos admonitura mei!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.43
passages.text: Iamque oculis ereptus eras. tum denique flevi;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.44
passages.text: Torpuerant molles ante dolore genae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.45
passages.text: Quid potius facerent, quam me mea lumina flerent,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.46
passages.text: Postquam desieram vela videre tua?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.47
passages.text: Aut ego diffusis erravi sola capillis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.48
passages.text: Qualis ab Ogygio concita Baccha deo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.49
passages.text: Aut mare prospiciens in saxo frigida sedi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.50
passages.text: Quamque lapis sedes, tam lapis ipsa fui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.51
passages.text: Saepe torum repeto, qui nos acceperat ambos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.52
passages.text: Sed non acceptos exhibiturus erat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.53
passages.text: Et tua, quae possum pro te, vestigia tango

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.54
passages.text: Strataque quae membris intepuere tuis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.55
passages.text: Incumbo, lacrimisque toro manante profusis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.56
passages.text: 'Pressimus,' exclamo, 'te duo — redde duos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.57
passages.text: Venimus huc ambo; cur non discedimus ambo?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.58
passages.text: Perfide, pars nostri, lectule, maior ubi est?'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.59
passages.text: Quid faciam? quo sola ferar? vacat insula cultu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.60
passages.text: Non hominum video, non ego facta boum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.61
passages.text: Omne latus terrae cingit mare; navita nusquam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.62
passages.text: Nulla per ambiguas puppis itura vias.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.63
passages.text: Finge dari comitesque mihi ventosque ratemque —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.64
passages.text: Quid sequar? accessus terra paterna negat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.65
passages.text: Ut rate felici pacata per aequora labar,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.66
passages.text: Temperet ut ventos Aeolus — exul ero!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.67
passages.text: Non ego te, Crete centum digesta per urbes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.68
passages.text: Adspiciam, puero cognita terra Iovi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.69
passages.text: Ut pater et tellus iusto regnata parenti

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.70
passages.text: Prodita sunt facto, nomina cara, meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.71
passages.text: Cum tibi, ne victor tecto morerere recurvo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.72
passages.text: Quae regerent passus, pro duce fila dedi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.73
passages.text: Tum mihi dicebas: 'per ego ipsa pericula iuro,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.74
passages.text: Te fore, dum nostrum vivet uterque, meam.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.75
passages.text: Vivimus, et non sum, Theseu, tua — si modo vivit

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.76
passages.text: Femina periuri fraude sepulta viri.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.77
passages.text: Me quoque, qua fratrem mactasses, inprobe, clava;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.78
passages.text: Esset, quam dederas, morte soluta fides.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.79
passages.text: Nunc ego non tantum, quae sum passura, recordor,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.80
passages.text: Et quaecumque potest ulla relicta pati:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.81
passages.text: Occurrunt animo pereundi mille figurae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.82
passages.text: Morsque minus poenae quam mora mortis habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.83
passages.text: Iam iam venturos aut hac aut suspicor illac,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.84
passages.text: Qui lanient avido viscera dente, lupos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.85
passages.text: Quis scit an et fulvos tellus alat ista leones?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.86
passages.text: Forsitan et saevas tigridas insula habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.87
passages.text: Et freta dicuntur magnas expellere phocas!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.88
passages.text: Quis vetat et gladios per latus ire meum?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.89
passages.text: Tantum ne religer dura captiva catena,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.90
passages.text: Neve traham serva grandia pensa manu,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.91
passages.text: Cui pater est Minos, cui mater filia Phoebi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.92
passages.text: Quodque magis memini, quae tibi pacta fui!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.93
passages.text: Si mare, si terras porrectaque litora vidi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.94
passages.text: Multa mihi terrae, multa minantur aquae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.95
passages.text: Caelum restabat — timeo simulacra deorum!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.96
passages.text: Destitutor rabidis praeda cibusque feris;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.97
passages.text: Sive colunt habitantque viri, diffidimus illis —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.98
passages.text: Externos didici laesa timere viros.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.99
passages.text: Viveret Androgeos utinam! nec facta luisses

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.100
passages.text: Inpia funeribus, Cecropi terra, tuis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.101
passages.text: Nec tua mactasset nodoso stipite, Theseu,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.102
passages.text: Ardua parte virum dextera, parte bovem;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.103
passages.text: Nec tibi, quae reditus monstrarent, fila dedissem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.104
passages.text: Fila per adductas saepe recepta manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.105
passages.text: Non equidem miror, si stat victoria tecum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.106
passages.text: Strataque Cretaeam belua planxit humum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.107
passages.text: Non poterant figi praecordia ferrea cornu;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.108
passages.text: Ut te non tegeres, pectore tutus eras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.109
passages.text: Illic tu silices, illic adamanta tulisti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.110
passages.text: Illic, qui silices, Thesea, vincat, habes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.111
passages.text: Crudeles somni, quid me tenuistis inertem?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.112
passages.text: Aut semel aeterna nocte premenda fui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.113
passages.text: Vos quoque crudeles, venti, nimiumque parati

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.114
passages.text: Flaminaque in lacrimas officiosa meas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.115
passages.text: Dextera crudelis, quae me fratremque necavit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.116
passages.text: Et data poscenti, nomen inane, fides!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.117
passages.text: In me iurarunt somnus ventusque fidesque;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.118
passages.text: Prodita sum causis una puella tribus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.119
passages.text: Ergo ego nec lacrimas matris moritura videbo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.120
passages.text: Nec, mea qui digitis lumina condat, erit?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.121
passages.text: Spiritus infelix peregrinas ibit in auras,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.122
passages.text: Nec positos artus unguet amica manus?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.123
passages.text: Ossa superstabunt volucres inhumata marinae?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.124
passages.text: Haec sunt officiis digna sepulcra meis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.125
passages.text: Ibis Cecropios portus patriaque receptus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.126
passages.text: Cum steteris turbae celsus in ore tuae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.127
passages.text: Et bene narraris letum taurique virique

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.128
passages.text: Sectaque per dubias saxea tecta vias,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.129
passages.text: Me quoque narrato sola tellure relictam!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.130
passages.text: Non ego sum titulis subripienda tuis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.131
passages.text: Nec pater est Aegeus, nec tu Pittheidos Aethrae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.132
passages.text: Filius; auctores saxa fretumque tui!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.133
passages.text: Di facerent, ut me summa de puppe videres;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.134
passages.text: Movisset vultus maesta figura tuos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.135
passages.text: Nunc quoque non oculis, sed, qua potes, adspice mente

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.136
passages.text: Haerentem scopulo, quem vaga pulsat aqua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.137
passages.text: Adspice demissos lugentis more capillos

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.138
passages.text: Et tunicas lacrimis sicut ab imbre gravis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.139
passages.text: Corpus, ut inpulsae segetes aquilonibus, horret,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.140
passages.text: Litteraque articulo pressa tremente labat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.141
passages.text: Non te per meritum, quoniam male cessit, adoro;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.142
passages.text: Debita sit facto gratia nulla meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.143
passages.text: Sed ne poena quidem! si non ego causa salutis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.144
passages.text: Non tamen est, cur sis tu mihi causa necis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.145
passages.text: Has tibi plangendo lugubria pectora lassas

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.146
passages.text: Infelix tendo trans freta lata manus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.147
passages.text: Hos tibi — qui superant — ostendo maesta capillos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.148
passages.text: Per lacrimas oro, quas tua facta movent —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.149
passages.text: Flecte ratem, Theseu, versoque relabere velo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 10.150
passages.text: Si prius occidero, tu tamen ossa feres!
